channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: Next step made on Penrhos Leisure Village
item.description: CG Recovery has launched a consultation to inform a reserved matters planning application for the 500-lodge Anglesey proposal. The post Next step made on Penrhos Leisure Village appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: CWAC approves 115 affordable Moulton homes
item.description: Keepmoat subsidiary MCI Developments’ residential plans for Cheshire survived a nearly two-hour debate at yesterday’s planning committee meeting, which followed a deferment from February. The post CWAC approves 115 affordable Moulton homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Embassy Club set for wrecking ball
item.description: Manchester City Council is close to a deal to purchase Bernard Manning’s former comedy club, which it wants to replace with a health centre as Harpurhey regeneration plans fall into place. The post Embassy Club set for wrecking ball appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: GMI to build part-timber Manchester office
item.description: Bywater has appointed the contractor to deliver the 87,000 sq ft redevelopment of 35 Fountain Street, which is targeting ultra-low embodied carbon levels. The post GMI to build part-timber Manchester office appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: What property should expect at the Greater Manchester local elections
item.description: An interesting wrinkle can be found in the Gorton and Denton election result by comparing it to recent council by-elections in Greater Manchester, writes Rob Loughenbury of Lexington. The post What property should expect at the Greater Manchester local elections appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wirral looks to redesign £26m Birkenhead waterfront project
item.description: In a bid to reduce costs, the council will vote on Tuesday whether to proceed with a value-engineered version of the scheme to improve the green spaces and active travel infrastructure in the area around Argyle Street, Hamilton Square, Hamilton Street, Woodside Gyratory, and the promenade. The post Wirral looks to redesign £26m Birkenhead waterfront project appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Prime Group ties up UK Events Group deal
item.description: The Manchester developer has sold or let all four units at its Prime Point Knowsley scheme to the occupier, accounting for close to 35,000 sq ft of industrial floorspace. The post Prime Group ties up UK Events Group deal appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: LOFT makes Trafford Park move
item.description: The Manchester-based furniture and interior design firm has signed a 10-year lease on a 45,000 sq ft unit at Indurent’s Longwood Estate off Hattons Road. The post LOFT makes Trafford Park move appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Scale of Eccles housing ambition revealed as 1,270-home masterplan emerges
item.description: A vision aimed at unlocking the town’s potential has been unveiled by Salford City Council and its development partner Muse, alongside fresh images of how Eccles could look in years to come. The post Scale of Eccles housing ambition revealed as 1,270-home masterplan emerges appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Blackburn finds new anchor for £45m skills campus after Uni of Lancashire drops out
item.description: Star Academies has agreed to purchase the freehold for the first building of the Levelling Up Fund project for £10.3m once it completes, renaming the development Star Square in the process. The post Blackburn finds new anchor for £45m skills campus after Uni of Lancashire drops out appeared first on Place North West.
